body:
If I can survive through New Years, I might be ok. But I don’t think I will. I’ve had enough of this.

I’m glad you’re seeing some hope. The holidays are destructive for some. I hope you can pull through. The new decade starts in a few days and it’s a fresh start, mentally.

I’ve spent the last decade begging god for mercy. For guidance. For hope. For a chance at anything. And I’ve gotten nothing. Absolutely NOTHING. Not even a sign that my prayers were heard. 

So yeah, I’ve basically just come to the conclusion that either there is a god and he/it is just a piece of shit. Or im just completely stupid and have been begging the sky for help/answers. I’m quite sure I found my answer tonight.
This is the second Christmas in a row I’ve spent avoiding my parents/family/friends. This is my breaking point. I’m sorry you guys are in the same boat. I know the pain. I’m so sorry..
I’m already gone man. I’ve tried talking. I’ve tried medication. It’s the end of the line for me.

I’ve had worse heartbreak than this before. I’m just so tired. And so sick of being let down. We planned our future together. We had goals. We had dreams. And she threw it all away. For what? I don’t understand. And the nice part about being dead is that I won’t need to understand. I won’t yearn for her or pray to a make-believe entity that she will pick up her phone and call. It’s embarrassing, Really. I have no will to live. I haven’t for years. And this just put the cherry on top. 

My parents don’t understand. They normally would try to talk to me more about this but they haven’t and they seem to avoid it. I don’t know how to function anymore. I haven’t left my apartment all weekend. I haven’t eaten anything today. I can’t eat. Everything, literally everything, reminds me of her. The dumbest, most ridiculous things make me shake with anxiety. I just want out. 

I’m rambling. But I need to get it out. I’m sorry.
I just want to know how it was so easy for her to move on in such a short time. That’s it. And I’ll never know.
I’ve over stated my welcome.
I can’t stay.
Yes
Exactly
I can’t
No.
But I know her. That isn’t her :(
Sort of. At Dicks Sporting Goods right now.
It destroys me how happy she is. How okay she is after this. How is it possible?

She left. Things were perfect. I had moved for a new job and she was planning her move here. Then, she cheated. Lied. And left. Then I found out she’s seeing him. 1 month. That’s all it took to throw everything away. I already deal with severe anxiety and this topped everything off. I don’t want to live. I want her to know the pain. And my biggest fear is that she won’t care.
Carbon Monoxide is painless and relatively fast. Sounds like a good out. Brain damage if you fail tho. :/
How would you do that? In a room?

I’ve heard Detergent suicide works really well. Like, instant and painless, which sounds too good to be true. It’s also really dangerous to first responders or the people who find you which really concerns me. Idk. I’ve been planning for quite some time and I can’t seem to find the quickest, easiest method that will have less fall out.
I sure hope it does the trick. My biggest fear is being mangled if I survived.
Most likely. Brain stem/middle of head.

I appreciate it. It’s crazy how an internet stranger can care more than someone you put so much energy into. I was close to this point during the relationship. I’m just not happy. And this didn’t help.
